Definition: properly, to be burly, i.e. (figuratively) powerful (passively, impregnable); by implication, to ravage
BiblicalUsage: 1) to deal violently with, despoil, devastate, ruin, destroy, spoil; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to violently destroy, devastate, despoil, assail; 1a2) devastator, despoiler (participle) (subst); 1b) (Niphal) to be utterly ruined; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to assault; 1c2) to devastate; 1d) (Pual) to be devastated; 1e) (Poel) to violently destroy; 1f) (Hophal) to be devastated
